Turn C 90 degrees anticlockwise: the line becomes /, the dot goes to the bottom-right on an L-shaped stand, and the wavy end goes to the lower-left. Option 2 fits. trick: For rotation questions, follow the dot: see where it goes from A to B, then move C's dot the same way.
